The '''Kwymar Sector Forces''', also known as the '''Kwymar Sector Fleet''', were the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Planetary Security Forces]] for the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]].

==History==
The Kwymar Sector Forces was active before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the unit, before resigning and entering the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]].

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Jason Fry]] introduced the Kwymar Sector Fleet in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1|''The Clone Wars: The Official Episode Guide: Season 1'']], published in [[October]] [[2009]]. He also referenced a "Kwymar Sector Forces" in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', released in [[April]] [[2012]], and later clarified that they were intended to be the same unit.<ref name="Fry e-mail">{{EmailCite|email=Wookieepedia:Email/Jason Fry (2013)|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2013-10-25}}</ref>
